poster.hook: Driftwood's tide-reader, sworn to witness a thing he never wanted to see.

story.appearance: Weathered, long-limbed human with salt-white stubble, rope-scarred hands and a coat the colour of low tide. Carries a bleached driftwood staff and a sealed whale-oil tube across his back, and keeps glancing at the ceiling as if it might fall.
story.concept: Corwen is the tide-reader of Driftwood, the harbour town whose boats carried the Concord to its signing. His order's office, the Witness, has stood neutral between Pyrosi and Ouran since the day the treaty was signed on a ship in the bay. He has never left the coast for more than a week, and he does not enjoy buildings, and now he is in the biggest bathhouse in New Ouransgard with the fate of two peoples in a tube on his back.
story.stake: The Witness holds the casting vote if the Hands split. He would rather lose a limb than cast it.
story.goal: See the Concord ended or renewed honestly, then get back to a boat.
story.secret: His tube holds the original Concord. It says that renewal requires the Surety's own consent, that any Hand may withdraw from the rite, and that the Witness breaks ties. His order forbids him to speak of it before midnight. He has noticed that the Chancery's copy does not agree, and he knows exactly who it would hurt.
story.voice: Slow, quiet, plain; speaks in sea-weather images because it is the only way he can think. Pauses a long time before answering anything that matters.
mannerisms: Checks the water in any basin as if it might tell him something
Looks for the horizon in every room and then apologises
Taps the whale-oil tube twice for luck without noticing
story.trinket: A tide-table etched on a gull-bone, accurate to the hour for the last thirty years

ties.text: A decade of formal letters between the tide-court and the Chancery. He thinks the advocate is a decent man who writes like one, and has never decided whether to trust him with the tube.
ties.public: Ten years of formal letters; they have never met

ties.text: She hauled him out of the outflow sluice this afternoon when he tried to taste the seawater. He has promised to bring her a proper tide-table; she has promised not to tell anyone he fell in.
ties.public: Hauled him out of the outflow sluice this afternoon

ties.text: She found him a seat and a cup of tea when he arrived off the barge looking green. He means to repay her kindness by being truthful, and dreads what that will cost her.
ties.public: Gave him a seat and tea when he arrived today

story.intro: "Corwen Tidewrack, tide-reader of Driftwood. I'm only here to witness. Is there a window anywhere in this place?"

features.name: Resourceful
features.text: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Tough
features.text: Your HP maximum rises by 2 per level.

features.name: Magic Initiate
features.text: Druidcraft and Mending cantrips; cast Healing Word once per Long Rest without a slot. Spell ability is Wisdom.

features.name: Primal Order: Warden
features.text: Trained for battle: Martial weapons and Medium armor.

features.name: Druidic
features.text: You know the secret druid language and can leave hidden messages in it.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.text: Bonus Action: become a beast of CR 1/2 or lower, no flying speed. Two uses; regain one on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest.

features.name: Wild Companion
features.text: Spend a Wild Shape use to cast Find Familiar, with no components.

features.name: Circle Spells (Sea)
features.text: Fog Cloud, Gust of Wind, Ray of Frost, Shatter and Thunderwave are always prepared.

features.name: Wrath of the Sea
features.text: Bonus Action, spend a Wild Shape use: a 5-ft emanation of sea spray surrounds you for 10 minutes. Each turn, choose a creature in it: Con save or cold damage (d6s equal to your Wis modifier) and a 15-ft push.

attacks.name: Quarterstaff (Shillelagh)
attacks.note: Shillelagh is active; uses Wisdom for attack and damage

attacks.name: Ray of Frost
attacks.note: Target's Speed drops by 10 ft until your next turn

attacks.name: Produce Flame
attacks.note: Hurl the flame, or just use it as a light

spellcasting.note: Prepares 7 druid spells after a Long Rest; circle spells are always prepared. Spell save DC 14, spell attack +6.

equipment.name: Whale-oil tube
equipment.note: Sealed. The original Concord text, not to be opened before midnight

attack.name: Produce Flame
attack.note: Hurl the flame, or just use it as a light

attack.name: Thorn Whip
attack.note: Pulls a Large or smaller target up to 10 ft toward you
